title: Chintamani Library v2.7.2 — Official Insignia Watermark, Clean WhatsApp Hub & Refined Controls
releaseNotes: OFFICIAL INSIGNIA WATERMARK: Centered official golden laurel wreath and 'Infinity under a roof' insignia watermark across all app pages and Universal QR portal with calibrated opacity for crisp readability
CLEAN WHATSAPP HUB: Purged claymorphic bubbles, neon glare, and glowing borders; sleek obsidian executive surfaces with solid status indicators and responsive messaging buttons
REFINED 4D CONTROLS & ICONS: Removed white specular highlight dots from all More section icons and cleaned seat/expiry dots from member cards
UNIFIED UNIVERSAL QR PORTAL: Universal QR screens now seamlessly showcase the centered insignia watermark in pure dark luxury
VERIFIED WORKFLOWS: Fully verified WhatsApp Auto Bot queue, broadcast flows, student direct messaging, and member action buttons
SEAMLESS OTA UPDATE: In-app instant auto-update delivery without manual APK installation
